Name: Shikari
Author: SorenWolfe
Punchline: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game.
Description:
Plan your raid strategy, follow your position during a pull, and review your movement afterwards.

• /shikari opens the planner; /shikari mini toggles the combat window; /shikari review opens replay.
• Draw slides with player positions, waymarks, AOEs, arrows, and notes.
• Link mechanics to slides and set cooldown reminders for each seat.
• Track your live position with a white diamond and your planned destination with a cyan crosshair. Matching waymarks are required for alignment.
• Review recorded attempts over the plan after a pull.
• Import raidplan.io boards, supported WTFDIG guides, or FF Logs timelines.
• Share plans with your group using a code.
